Questions people ask

How do I cancel Winkaboo Unlimited?
  1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
  2. Tap your name at the top (your Apple Account), then Subscriptions.
  3. Choose Winkaboo and tap Cancel Subscription.

You keep Winkaboo Unlimited until the end of the period you have paid for. Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.

How do I cancel the free trial so I’m not charged?

Cancel it the same way, at least 24 hours before the 3-day trial ends. Otherwise it converts to the paid yearly plan.

How do I restore my purchase?

Sign in to the same Apple Account you bought with, open Winkaboo and tap Restore on the Winkaboo Unlimited screen, or Restore purchases in Winkaboo’s Settings. If it doesn’t come back, email us.

How do the free shots work?

A shot is one caught moment, kept as its best frame. Winkaboo is free with 5 shots a day, and the count starts over each day. Winkaboo Unlimited removes the limit.

Where are my photos kept?

On your phone, in Winkaboo’s gallery. Best frames stay until you delete them; backups (unless you saved them to Photos) and the short clip of each moment are kept for 30 days. A photo goes into your Photos library only when you ask. Winkaboo’s own copies are not in device backups, so deleting the app deletes them. Save what you want to keep to Photos first.

How do I delete a shot?

Open the gallery in Winkaboo and delete a shot, which is one caught moment. This removes it from the app, not from Photos. To remove a picture from Photos, delete it there.

Is my camera feed uploaded?

No. Winkaboo reads the camera on your phone, and nothing it sees is uploaded. Your shots stay on your phone unless you save them to Photos or share them yourself. See the Privacy Policy.

Does Winkaboo use AI?

Yes. Winkaboo is calibrated on how professional photographers shoot people: it finds the person, reads the pose and the framing, checks every frame for sharpness and open eyes, and keeps the best one. How your data is handled is in the Privacy Policy.

Can I get a refund?

Purchases go through Apple, so Apple handles refunds. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com.
